name: Blockbuster Studio – AI Film Studio (Wan 2.2)
readme:
# Blockbuster Studio – AI Film Studio (Wan 2.2)

Your own AI film studio on one GPU: images, video, character-consistent editing, camera angles,
storyboards with location maps, and film export. Self-hosted, with no per-generation fees.

## Quick start

1. Deploy on an **RTX 4090 24 GB** (default) or a faster card (5090 / L40S).
2. Optional: set **STUDIO_PASSWORD**. Otherwise you create your password the first time you open
   the studio (within 15 minutes of the pod starting; restart the pod to reopen setup).
3. Open **Connect → HTTP Service (port 3000)**. The studio is up in ~2 minutes. Images work at
   ~3 minutes, and video + editing at ~6–18 minutes while models (~139 GB) download.

Optional keys (Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible for AI script breakdown, Civitai, Hugging Face) are
entered in the studio's **Settings** page.

## Storage

Everything lives on the `/workspace` volume. Stopping the pod keeps it; terminating deletes it.

## If you see "This Runpod machine's GPU isn't working"

Some community machines have a faulty GPU. Terminate the pod and deploy again.
